verdict.rationale: Keycloak is an identity and access management server (OIDC/OAuth 2.0/SAML, federation, authorization services). It is not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP client or tool-consumption capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
